ofertas.descripcion:
I’m looking for an experienced Squarespace designer to redesign my existing eight-page personal
training and wellness website.
The website is already live and contains most of the required pages and content. However, the
current design feels dated and no longer reflects the professional direction of the brand. I would
like the website to have a cleaner, more sophisticated, and modern appearance while remaining
warm and approachable to potential clients.
This is primarily a redesign and content update project. The existing website structure and
content can be used as a starting point, but the selected freelancer should improve how the
information is organized and presented across the website.
Some updated text and images will be provided to replace existing content. The homepage and
service pages will require the most attention, but the new visual direction should be applied
consistently across all eight pages.
The project will include:
• Redesigning the existing eight-page Squarespace website
• Creating a more polished and consistent visual direction
• Improving the homepage layout and presentation
• Making the personal training and wellness services easier to understand
• Improving the visual hierarchy of headings, text, images, and buttons
• Updating selected text, images, and website sections
• Improving spacing, alignment, typography, and section flow
• Strengthening the navigation and overall user experience
• Connecting important buttons to the correct pages or sections

ofertas.titulo: GOODKID — Logo & Custom Wordmark Design
ofertas.descripcion:
GOODKID Exterior Co. is a new Southern California exterior home-services company built around youth, work, independence, mischief, and optimism.
We’re looking for an original logo and custom wordmark that gives GOODKID the foundation of a brand people would actually want to wear, not another conventional home-services identity.
The visual world draws inspiration from vintage athletics and Little League, surf/skate culture, old American workwear, neighborhood entrepreneurship, and Southern California. Think youthful but not childish; nostalgic but not fake-vintage; confident but not macho; handmade but not amateur.
We do NOT have a predetermined symbol, mascot, icon, or graphic device. We want the designer to interpret the brand and surprise us.
Most importantly: this should NOT look like a typical home-services company. No houses, rooflines, sparkling windows, crossed tools, generic contractor shields, or stock service-business imagery. Also, this should be an original design, not AI generated.
GOODKID is the hero. “Exterior Co.” is secondary.
Budget: approximately $500–$1,000 USD.

I’m Alec, founder of OOBE Studios: an emerging independent game development studio focused on pairing tight, tactile game mechanics with deep narrative subversion.
I’m looking for creative talent to build our visual identity, starting with its core: the studio logo. 
OOBE stands for OUT OF BOUNDS ENCOUNTER. The name itself acts as a narrative trigger. It evokes that eerie moment when a player breaches the safe geometry of a virtual environment and meets the unexplainable - an unexpected presence in the void, an interaction with something that was never meant to exist. An exo-suited null-diver reaching across the cosmic edge colliding with his chromatic antithesis.… I want our logo to carry that imaginative narration, that exact same provocative weight.
When I picture our studio logo, I think less about "playful indie" and more about cyber-brutalism meets Tokyo-noir in negative space. Based on our visual anchors, I tend to picture a cold, monochromatic, iconic feel to the mark, but I don't shy away from a contrasty color accent that may underline the studio's visual statement.
My inspirations are the tech-brutalism of Kojima Productions, the Lovecraftian suspense of Nightdive Studios, and the cold, raw punch of tech-punk aesthetics from ACRNM. If the logo were a playlist, it would land somewhere between "Fleure" by Autechre and “Intro (The Full Horror) by SOPHIE.
